stories.title: Prof accoltellata, si indaga sulla rete del 13enne:”Arruolato dai gruppi suprematisti”

en.title: Teacher stabbed, investigation into 13-year-old's network: 'Recruited by supremacist groups'
en.summary: A 13-year-old recorded a video call of an attack on teacher Isabella Marsilio. A juvenile court has opened an inquiry to assess educational measures for the suspect.

stories.title: Houthi, 'non siamo in guerra con l'Italia ma i vostri aerei sono in Arabia Saudita'

en.title: Houthi: 'We are not at war with Italy but your aircraft are in Saudi Arabia'
en.summary: The Sanaa government stated it does not seek to involve Italy in conflict but is defending itself against aggression, citing the presence of Italian aircraft in the region.

stories.title: Alta tensione tra Riad e le milizie Houthi: "Non siamo in guerra con l'Italia"

en.title: High tension between Riyadh and Houthi militias: 'We are not at war with Italy'
en.summary: Two explosions occurred in Saudi Arabia as Iran-backed Yemeni militias sought to control the Red Sea. An Italian Eurofighter was damaged in an attack on a Saudi base two days prior.

stories.title: Gli Houthi avvertono l’Italia: “Non siamo in guerra con voi, ma i vostri aerei sono lì”. Piano della Difesa per proteggere i militari. Attacco a Riad

en.title: Houthis warn Italy: 'We are not at war with you, but your aircraft are there.' Defense plan to protect soldiers. Attack on Riyadh
en.summary: Drones and missiles struck Riyadh and other Saudi cities overnight, injuring 13 civilians. Houthi forces warned Italy not to support operations against Yemen.

stories.title: I capolavori di Sandro Mazzola, morto a 83 anni: i dieci migliori gol con la sua Inter

en.title: The masterpieces of Sandro Mazzola, died at 83: his ten best goals with Inter
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, a legendary Inter player, has passed away at age 83. The outlet highlights his ten greatest goals scored for the club.

stories.title: La prima Coppa dei Campioni dell'Inter di Herrera nel 1964: l'Italia correva con Mazzola

en.title: Inter's first European Cup under Herrera in 1964: Italy ran with Mazzola
en.summary: The article recalls Inter's 1964 European Cup victory, noting Mazzola's connection to his father Valentino and his descendants who continue the family legacy.

stories.title: Morto Sandro Mazzola, Rivera: “eravamo amici”. L’Inter: “Ha scritto la storia”

en.title: Sandro Mazzola dead, Rivera: "we were friends". Inter: "He wrote history"
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, an Inter and national team star, died at 83. Tributes came from the sports world and institutions, including a statement from rival Rivera.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola, il figlio del Grande Torino diventato icona dell’Inter

en.title: Sandro Mazzola, son of Grande Torino who became an Inter icon
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, son of Valentino Mazzola, won four Serie A titles and two European Cups during 17 seasons with Inter. He also won the 1968 European Championship with Italy.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola, la rivalità con Rivera e la “staffetta” in Nazionale

en.title: Sandro Mazzola, the rivalry with Rivera and the "relay" in the National team
en.summary: Mazzola and Rivera embodied a long-standing rivalry between Inter and Milan that shaped Italian football, most controversially through their rotation at the 1970 World Cup.

stories.title: Sandro Mazzola è morto, bandiera dell’Inter e azzurro meraviglioso: aveva 83 anni

en.title: Sandro Mazzola dies, Inter legend and exceptional Italian player: aged 83
en.summary: Sandro Mazzola, son of Valentino and a European champion in 1968 who played for both Inter Milan and the Italian national team, has passed away at 83.

stories.title: Trump annuncia l'accordo sulla Groenlandia: “Controlleremo la sua sicurezza”

en.title: Trump announces agreement on Greenland: "We will control its security"
en.summary: Trump announced an agreement regarding Greenland that prevents China, Russia, and non-NATO countries from establishing military bases or stationing troops there.

stories.title: Guerra in Iran, news di oggi. Houthi: “Non siamo in guerra con l’Italia, ma voi sostenete Riad”

en.title: War in Iran, today's news. Houthis: "We are not at war with Italy, but you support Riyadh"
en.summary: Houthis stated they are not at war with Italy after an attack on a Saudi base destroyed an Italian fighter jet. The Washington Post reported the Pentagon concealed casualty numbers of US military personnel in the Middle East.

stories.title: Seda vince l’European Carton Excellence Award 2026 con un nuovo imballaggio

en.title: Seda wins European Carton Excellence Award 2026 with new packaging
en.summary: Seda International Packaging Group won the Food category of the European Carton Excellence Award 2026 with an innovative cardboard packaging solution called Da Vinci Clamshell for food service.

stories.title: Chimica e farmaceutica lanciano un’analsul lavoro e la svolta tecnologica

en.title: Chemistry and pharmaceuticals launch analysis on work and technological shift
en.summary: The chemistry and pharmaceutical sectors are conducting a study through the University of Milan to examine labor developments and technological changes, with results informing future industrial relations discussions.

stories.title: Sanlorenzo: «Con Swan integrazione chiusa molto positivamente»

en.title: Sanlorenzo: Swan integration closure very positive
en.summary: Sanlorenzo reports positive completion of the Swan integration, with activity continuing at the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda during the 23rd Rolex Swan Cup regatta.

stories.title: Meccanica, Stm accelera sul mercato inglese

en.title: Mechanics, Stm accelerates in the English market
en.summary: Stm, a Bologna-based reducer and geared motor manufacturer, is expanding its UK presence beyond its current commercial operations with new market development plans.

stories.title: Biomedicale, da Palermo la rete delle competenze

en.title: Biomedical, competence network from Palermo
en.summary: Twenty new biomedical and biotech laboratories have opened in Palermo, creating an integrated network connecting education, industry, research, and healthcare systems.
